answer: The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, split across independent auditors, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain. A orchard of per-task receipts records who did what, and the lagoon of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. Reaching the sparrow of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work.
